note: Authored fixtures, not sampled traffic. Expectations were recorded from observed engine behaviour and then pinned, so this measures the evaluation contract against regression. It is not a population-level accuracy estimate.

cases.description: A calendar-invalid date (2024-02-30). Recorded as a KNOWN GAP: Core does not reject it the way the Worker ingestion path does, so it rolls to 1 March and scores as merely old rather than as untrustworthy.

assert.known_gap: Core normalizeSignal accepts a calendar-invalid date that JS Date rolls forward. The Worker DAR path rejects it via an ISO round-trip check; Core does not. Pinned so the gap is visible and so closing it shows up as a benchmark change.

families.name: failure-honesty
